violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no certified food manager at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Certified food manager arrived during inspection.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: white cheese in three compartment sink at ambient temperature (73F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Person in charge placed cheese in cooler for the remainder of the thawing process.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager at the start of the inspection. It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Certified food manager arrived shortly after inspection started. Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: CFM was instructed to purchase a food thermometer. A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: syrups, flour, sugar, flavorings.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Single service forks and knives observed stored at random. Food contact surface is not protected.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed boxes of single service items stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor, on approved shelving. JUICE TIME & PAPA KANAFA (Inspection Date: 09/22/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: Phillips coffee machine and pancake maker. Both observed not NSF or equivalent.
violations.corrective_action: All equipment must be NSF or equivalent. Please provide different models that meet this requirement. Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions.
